title: Communal Wood Firing - Montanagama
commitment: 4–7 stoking shifts (6–8 hours each); Montanagama fired once or twice a year for 5–7 days
cost_text: $400–$500 per person; includes all wood, technical guidance from Jerry, mentorship, and hands-on experience in wadding, loading, and stoking
pay_text: Paid per person plus crew shifts required
summary: Potters can participate in communal firings of Jerry Baldwin's Montanagama (Anagama-style wood kiln) in Arlee, Montana for $400–$500 per person. Bring bisqued pots and commit to 4–7 stoking shifts (6–8 hours each). Firings happen once or twice yearly over 5–7 days. Call 406.544.2468 to arrange.
source_quote: Jerry invites potters to participate in communal firings of the Montanagama or Cat Kiln. Space is limited, and spots often fill quickly... Montanagama: $400–$500 per person
evidence_sentence: The Community Kilns page describes communal wood firings of the Montanagama with stoking shifts required and pricing from $400–$500 per person.
evidence_quote: The Montanagama, a compact Anagama-style kiln
